lines.text: “做生意的人那么多，我最信得过的，就是那个往门缝里塞纸条的英国人。”
lines.py: “zuò shēng yì de rén nà me duō, wǒ zuì xìn de guò de, jiù shì nà ge wǎng mén fèng lǐ sāi zhǐ tiáo de yīng guó rén.”
lines.en: "There are so many people in business, but the one I trust most is the British guy who slipped a note under my door."
